title: &aThe Machine Age
subtitle: Mekanism: power, steel, ore that multiplies, and the MekaSuit.

quests.title: Osmium
quests.subtitle: Mekanism
desc: &eMekanism&r is industry: machines that process ore, chemicals and energy. Almost all of them start with &eosmium&r.
Smelt some osmium ingots. JEI (press &eU&r on an item) shows every machine that uses it.

quests.title: The Metallurgic Infuser
desc: Your first machine. The &eMetallurgic Infuser&r soaks metal in an infusion type: iron with carbon (coal) becomes Enriched Iron and then &esteel&r, copper with redstone becomes &eInfused Alloy&r.
Steel is the backbone of every other Mekanism machine.

quests.title: Steel Casing
desc: Steel, osmium and glass make a &eSteel Casing&r: the frame of almost every Mekanism machine.
Make a few. You'll need them for everything from here on.

quests.title: Power Up
quests.subtitle: Mekanism Generators
desc: Mekanism machines run on energy (they take FE too). A &eHeat Generator&r burns lava or fuel; solar and wind generators make free power; a Create alternator works as well.
Build a Heat Generator to start.

quests.title: Cables and Cubes
desc: &eUniversal Cables&r carry power; an &eEnergy Cube&r stores it. Use a &eConfigurator&r on a machine to set which side takes power, items or chemicals in and out (each side shows a colour).
Build an Energy Cube and wire your generator to it.

quests.title: Two for One
quests.subtitle: Ore processing, tier 1
desc: Mekanism multiplies ore. An &eEnrichment Chamber&r turns one ore into &etwo&r dusts; smelt them for two ingots.
Every later tier builds on the one before, so keep this machine.

quests.title: Three for One
desc: A &ePurification Chamber&r fed with &eoxygen&r turns ore into three clumps. Crush them, enrich them, smelt them.
Get oxygen (and hydrogen) by splitting water in an &eElectrolytic Separator&r.

quests.title: Four for One
desc: A &eChemical Injection Chamber&r fed with &ehydrogen chloride&r turns ore into four shards, which go down the purification line.
Hydrogen chloride comes from hydrogen and chlorine (from salt water) in a Chemical Infuser.

quests.title: Five for One
desc: The top tier: dissolve ore in sulfuric acid (&eChemical Dissolution Chamber&r), clean the slurry (&eChemical Washer&r), and grow crystals (&eChemical Crystallizer&r). Five ingots per ore.
A big build, but it pays back every ore you ever mine. Orange Hoardwardens approve.

quests.title: Factories
desc: Right-click a machine with a &eTier Installer&r and it becomes a &eFactory&r that works on several items at once (three, five, seven, nine as you upgrade).
Speed and Energy Upgrades in its upgrade slot make it faster or cheaper.

quests.title: The Digital Miner
desc: The &eDigital Miner&r mines a huge area underground for you, picking only the blocks you filter for (ores, say) and leaving the rest.
It needs a lot of power. Put it in a forceloaded, claimed chunk and it keeps mining while you're off adventuring.

quests.title: Hydrogen Flight
desc: A &eJetpack&r burns hydrogen to fly. Fill it from a chemical tank fed by your Electrolytic Separator.
Hold jump to rise. Good for scouting and for reaching floating islands before you have an airship or a ring.

quests.title: The Alloy Ladder
desc: Infused Alloy (copper and redstone), then &eReinforced Alloy&r (with diamond), then &eAtomic Alloy&r (with refined obsidian). Each tier of machine and circuit needs the next alloy.
Make Atomic Alloy.

quests.title: Ultimate Control Circuit
desc: Circuits follow the alloys: Basic, Advanced, Elite, &eUltimate&r. Ultimate circuits go into the best machines and the MekaSuit.
Make one.

quests.title: Polonium
desc: The MekaSuit needs &epolonium&r. A &eFission Reactor&r makes nuclear waste; a &eSolar Neutron Activator&r turns it into polonium.
&cRadiation is real here.&r Wear a Hazmat suit, carry a Dosimeter, and never break a tank of waste. Build it far from home.

quests.title: The Modification Station
desc: MekaSuit pieces and the Meka-Tool take &emodules&r (jetpack, nutrition, vision, speed, shields...). You install them at the &eModification Station&r.
Build one.

quests.title: The MekaSuit
desc: The &eMekaSuit&r: powered armour that absorbs huge damage, flies with its jetpack unit, feeds you, filters the air and more, all from its battery.
Its parts need HDPE, ultimate circuits and polonium. The Stormwright's late-game armour, and a fine one for anyone.

quests.title: Fully Loaded
desc: Fill your MekaSuit with modules until it can't take any more.
Optional. The corruption has never met anything like you.
